body:
## What it does

Research only, and worth being precise about: it holds no funds and is not a wallet. It reviews a single position against your own policy and tells you whether a high headline yield actually clears it. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @MyEnsNames shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
